repairs.reported_issue: Goes to sleep during meetings. Asks for five more minutes on wake.
repairs.work: Reproduced the issue with a 42-slide presentation. Technician also fell asleep.

repairs.reported_issue: Double-clicks whenever anyone says cheese.

repairs.notes: Test print left in the tray.
repairs.reported_issue: Prints BOO on page two and insists page one never existed.
repairs.work: Ordered a new paper sensor. Ghost not included.

repairs.reported_issue: Caps Lock physically growls. Space bar requests a bigger office.
repairs.work: Replaced the Caps Lock switch. Growling now within office tolerance.

repairs.reported_issue: Repeats every packet three times and demands a cracker.
repairs.work: Disabled legacy repeater mode. Customer is testing on the upstairs landing.

repairs.reported_issue: Shows 99 percent until you plug something in. Then it needs a lie-down.
repairs.work: Pack failed its load test. Replacement recommended; awaiting pickup.

repairs.reported_issue: Touchscreen registers every swipe as stirring clockwise.
repairs.work: Replaced the touch digitizer. Confirmed taps and swipes work without a ladle.

repairs.notes: Test on a wired connection first.
repairs.reported_issue: The left stick drifts toward the snack cupboard.
repairs.work: Fitted a new stick module. Customer collected it after a drift-free test.

repairs.reported_issue: Answers every question with a dramatic sigh and a weather forecast for Mars.
Shows last Tuesday in the top-left corner of every window.
repairs.work: Confirmed panel persistence on a second input. Waiting for a replacement panel.

repairs.reported_issue: Only recognizes USB sticks introduced by their full legal name.
repairs.work: Intermittent connection isolated to port four. Testing the upstream cable next.

repairs.reported_issue: Prints every serial number as PROPERTY OF THE TOAD.
repairs.work: Cleared the custom label template. Test labels now show the actual serial.

repairs.reported_issue: Rings at noon and displays a note saying mornings were not in its contract.
Left earcup plays music. Right earcup occasionally says, 'I hear you.'
repairs.work: Replaced the damaged jack. Both channels now play music and neither offers emotional support.

repairs.reported_issue: Jumps to the last page and puts 'I told you so' in the margin.
repairs.work: Replaced the sticky page-turn switch. Customer requested a spoiler-free test book.

repairs.reported_issue: Pauses during boss fights to recommend a sensible bedtime.
repairs.work: Found a worn pause button. The bedtime advice appears to be a separate issue.

repairs.notes: Test with the original USB cable.
repairs.reported_issue: Tracks houseplants perfectly but blurs anyone presenting quarterly results.
repairs.work: Reset the autofocus profile. Confirmed sharp footage of one technician and a very photogenic fern.

repairs.reported_issue: Weighs flour accurately but adds 30 grams of disappointment to every cake.
repairs.work: Load cell drifts under sustained weight. Ordered a replacement with no opinion about baking.

repairs.reported_issue: Clicks twice and only mounts on Wednesdays if the USB cable is wearing a rubber band.
repairs.work: Confirmed mechanical failure. Returned the drive unopened for specialist recovery.

repairs.reported_issue: Sets the room to 21 degrees, then drops to 16 whenever someone says 'cozy.'
repairs.work: Disabled the faulty voice shortcut. Verified a stable setpoint through three deliberate uses of the word cozy.
